composerMarkup:
CkretguardLOCAL PROMPT GUARD

OFFLINE
Local composer ready · Open ChatGPT or Claude in Chrome for supported input protection. Reload existing tabs after installing.
SHARE THE QUESTION. KEEP THE SECRET.

A little less
exposure.

Mask sensitive text here before it touches an AI website. Your text stays in this window.

Private composer

100,000 character limit
Ready. Scanning runs entirely on this device.
Protection settings

Ckretguard by Orenthic

Local scanning. No server. No prompt history.

On supported chat pages, detected credentials pause sending with Send, Edit, and Mask choices. Mask replaces detected values with xxxxx and sends the masked prompt. Websites can see text typed into their pages. Files, images, voice, and other apps are outside this version’s coverage. No detector finds every secret.

composerStates.text: Draft changed. Mask it again before copying.
composerStates.title: Draft changed
composerStates.when: Editing the draft invalidates the previous masked result.

composerStates.text: No supported secret pattern found. Review the result; detection is not exhaustive.
composerStates.title: No supported pattern found
composerStates.when: The local scan finds no recognized credential pattern.

composerStates.text: 1 possible secret masked. Review the result.
composerStates.title: One credential masked
composerStates.when: The local scanner masks one detected occurrence.

composerStates.text: 2 possible secrets masked. Review the result.
composerStates.title: Multiple credentials masked
composerStates.when: The number reflects the detected occurrences.

composerStates.text: Could not scan. Keep this text local and shorten it or reload the policy.
composerStates.title: Local scan failed
composerStates.when: The local scan or policy is unavailable or the input cannot be processed.

composerStates.text: Text cleared from this window.
composerStates.title: Text cleared
composerStates.when: Clear removes the draft and masked result from this window.

composerStates.text: Masked text copied. Your clipboard now contains this result.
composerStates.title: Copy succeeded
composerStates.when: Copy masked text writes the reviewed result to the clipboard.

composerStates.text: Could not copy. Mask again or select the reviewed masked text manually.
composerStates.title: Copy failed
composerStates.when: Clipboard copying fails or the reviewed result is no longer safe to copy.

composerStates.text: Managed by your organization
composerStates.title: Managed settings
composerStates.when: Organization policy locks one or more protection fields.

composerStates.text: Ready. Scanning runs entirely on this device.
composerStates.title: Composer ready
composerStates.when: Local policy has loaded successfully.

composerStates.text: Policy unavailable. Scanning and copying are paused. Reload the extension.
composerStates.title: Composer policy unavailable
composerStates.when: Policy loading fails; masking and copying are paused.

composerStates.text: Settings saved. Managed settings always take precedence.
composerStates.title: Settings saved
composerStates.when: The protection settings have been saved successfully.

composerStates.text: Could not save. Use up to 30 field names of 2–64 letters, digits, spaces, underscores or hyphens.
composerStates.title: Settings could not save
composerStates.when: Settings are invalid or writing settings fails.

composerStates.text: ChatGPT · guard unavailable or input not recognized. Use this local composer.
composerStates.title: ChatGPT guard unavailable
composerStates.when: The ChatGPT input is not uniquely recognized or its policy is not ready.

composerStates.text: ChatGPT input recognized · prompt guard ready. Coverage is limited to supported input and send controls.
composerStates.title: ChatGPT guard ready
composerStates.when: The active ChatGPT tab reports one supported input and a loaded policy.

composerStates.text: Claude · guard unavailable or input not recognized. Use this local composer.
composerStates.title: Claude guard unavailable
composerStates.when: The Claude input is not uniquely recognized or its policy is not ready.

composerStates.text: Claude input recognized · prompt guard ready. Coverage is limited to supported input and send controls.
composerStates.title: Claude guard ready
composerStates.when: The active Claude tab reports one supported input and a loaded policy.

composerStates.text: Local composer ready · Open ChatGPT or Claude in Chrome for supported input protection. Reload existing tabs after installing.
composerStates.title: No supported active chat
composerStates.when: No supported tab can be reached, including a tab needing refresh.

composerStates.text: Checking chat input coverage…
composerStates.title: Checking the active tab
composerStates.when: The extension window is checking input coverage.

composerStates.text: Loading local policy…
composerStates.title: Loading composer policy
composerStates.when: The extension window has opened and local policy is loading.
